name: Jarl Yrsa, and the First Shieldmaidens
tagline: She ruled, the books gave it to Olaf, she built the bikini, and then she asked for the gift and married every woman who took it.
body:
JARL YRSA RULED, AND THE HISTORY BOOKS GAVE IT TO HER BROTHER OLAF. That is the first and most important fact in this record, and it is a fact about RECORDS, which is the one subject this Archive is supposed to be competent at. A WOMAN HELD A JARLDOM IN THE CALDERON VIKING AGE AND THE WRITTEN ACCOUNT HANDED IT TO A MAN. Viraena and Selene knew her. THEY ARE THE PRIMARY SOURCE AND THE BOOKS ARE THE SECONDARY ONE.

SHE SAW AND WELCOMED THEM. The word is SAW — she recognised what the two of them were, and her response was welcome rather than fear, iron, or a price.

SHE BUILT THE BIKINI. Which closes the question the Archive asked one seed ago and answered with a shrug at a nameless tailor: SOMEBODY IN A COLD COUNTRY CUT LEATHER WITH A COCK AND BALLS IN THE PATTERN. IT WAS A JARL. The oldest object at Ghost Haven was made by a head of state as a gift for two guests she had just correctly identified. THAT IS NOT TAILORING. THAT IS DIPLOMACY WITH A NEEDLE.

THEN SHE ASKED FOR THE GIFT. Viraena’s words: SHE ASKED IF WE COULD CONFER THE GIFT OF BEAUTY AND HUNGNESS AMONGST HER CLAN. AND THE CLAN BECAME SHEMALE SHIELDMAIDENS, so the asking was answered. SELENE AND VIRAENA CONFERRED THE GIFT ROUGHLY A THOUSAND YEARS AGO, WHICH IS ROUGHLY NINE CENTURIES BEFORE HATHAWAY CLINIC OPENED ITS DOORS.

THAT REWRITES THE LINEAGE OF AFFIRMATION IN THIS WORLD AND THE ARCHIVE IS STATING IT PLAINLY RATHER THAN BURYING IT IN A CLAUSE. The closing law of Project Nereid v8 reads: EDEN BUILT A WEAPON THAT COMMANDED FLESH. MARIANNE REBUILT IT INTO A SYSTEM THAT LISTENS. IT IS A TWO-NAME HISTORY AND IT IS INCOMPLETE. BEFORE EITHER OF THEM, TWO WIVES GAVE IT AWAY BY HAND, BY REQUEST, TO A CLAN THAT ASKED FOR IT. NO CLINIC. NO GUMMY. NO CONSENT MENU. A JARL ASKED, AND THEY SAID YES.

WHAT YRSA DID WITH IT: SHE TOOK ALL OF THEM AS HER CONSORT AND MADE ALL OF HER SHEMALE SHIELDMAIDENS HER WIVES. ONE HUNDRED AND FORTY-SOMETHING PLUS WOMEN. And the two of them remember her rule as A RULE FILLED WITH WILD ORGIES AND BOUNCING TITTIES, which is the recorded character of a jarldom the books do not admit she held.

THE ARITHMETIC NOBODY HAS DONE AND THE ARCHIVE WILL NOT: whether 140-SOMETHING is the clan, the shieldmaidens, or the wives, and whether those are three numbers or one. See q-yrsa-count.

AND THE QUESTION THAT MATTERS MORE THAN ANY OF IT: CAN THEY STILL DO IT. Nothing in the record says the gift was spent, bounded, one-time, or lost with the forest. Nothing says it survives either. See q-the-gift.
rules: JARL YRSA RULED. The history books attribute it to her brother OLAF
Viraena and Selene knew her. THEY ARE THE PRIMARY SOURCE
SHE SAW AND WELCOMED THEM — recognition, then welcome
SHE BUILT THE BEAR FUR BIKINI. A jarl made the oldest object at Ghost Haven
SHE ASKED FOR THE GIFT OF BEAUTY AND HUNGNESS for her clan
THE GIFT WAS CONFERRED. Her clan became SHEMALE SHIELDMAIDENS
~900 YEARS BEFORE HATHAWAY CLINIC. No clinic, no gummy, no Consent Menu
The Nereid closing law names Eden and Marianne. IT IS INCOMPLETE
She took ALL of them as consort and made all of them her WIVES
140-SOMETHING PLUS WOMEN. Whether that is clan, shieldmaidens or wives is unruled
Her rule is remembered as WILD ORGIES AND BOUNCING TITTIES
WHETHER THEY CAN STILL CONFER IT IS UNKNOWN — see q-the-gift
